claims.statement: Visa's merchant guidance describes a formal dispute response in which merchants submit supporting transaction, shipping and communication evidence through the acquirer.
Visa publishes merchant guidance for Compelling Evidence and scheme-specific dispute management.

contrary_evidence: Visa and existing payment providers already offer dispute tools, so a new entrant needs a vertical evidence source they do not control.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Privacy-preserving verified decisions reveal which evidence combinations work by reason code and merchant type
fingerprint.customer: Digital-goods, subscription and ecommerce merchants reached through PSPs or vertical platforms
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: PSP, acquirer, marketplace and vertical-SaaS embedding
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Evidence retrieval, representment packet and outcome reconciliation for a success fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The merchant or payment partner pays when the disputed funds are restored or a pre-dispute is resolved
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An issuer opens a card dispute and the merchant has a finite response window

structure.control_point: The normalized evidence graph linked to the final dispute decision and recovered transaction
structure.critical_dependency: Payment-provider integration, strict data minimization and scheme-compliant use of cross-merchant outcome signals

thesis: Embed with vertical SaaS platforms, marketplaces or acquirers to collect consented order, delivery, device, login and usage evidence before a dispute window closes. Generate scheme-specific evidence, submit through the merchant's payment provider, and charge only when an issuer or acquirer confirms recovered funds. Privacy-preserving outcome learning across participating merchants creates a stronger evidence-selection asset without exposing raw customer data.
title: Chargeback Evidence Cooperative
